summary: Join our Leadership and Strategic Thinking course tailored for the tech industry. Develop essential skills to lead effectively and innovate in your field.
lede: Leadership and strategic thinking in the tech industry helps professionals connect technical complexity with business value while making sound decisions in high-uncertainty environments. This course develops that capability through value chain mapping, architectural alignment, performance metrics, financial literacy, and stakeholder influence. You will practice building OKR frameworks, assessing technology debt, applying DORA metrics and Conway’s Law, and creating communication plans for non-technical executives. By combining data-driven analysis with human-centric leadership, you will learn to shape cohesive strategies and lead digital transformation initiatives that are technically sound and commercially viable.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for technical professionals transitioning into leadership roles and current managers seeking to sharpen their strategic acumen within the technology sector.
audience: Chief Technology Officers (CTOs) in mid-sized firms
modules: Tech Leadership Foundations and Industry Context
Financial Literacy and Technical Debt Management
Leading Digital Transformation and AI Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in a technical role (Software Engineering, IT Operations, Data Science, or Product Management). Previous experience leading a team or project is recommended but not required. Familiarity with basic Agile® principles and software development lifecycles will be beneficial.
